boundaries.name: json-host-callbacks
boundaries.obligation: JSON.stringify / JSON.parse are opaque `Host` callbacks; the wire-alias comparison of `field` and the parse of the WASM result/state inherit their semantics, with SyntaxError as the only modeled parse failure.

boundaries.name: wire-splice
boundaries.obligation: The indexOf/slice splice of the stored signature into the co-sign wire is opaque (`Host.occurrences`, `Host.replaceFirst`); that the fresh signature text occurs exactly once and that the splice yields a valid wire is not proved.

boundaries.name: unsigned-proposal-regex
boundaries.obligation: The memberSignatures regex screening unsigned delegate proposals is the opaque predicate `Host.wireCarriesMemberSignatures`; that it detects every signature-bearing wire is not proved.

boundaries.name: indexeddb-durability-and-serialization
boundaries.obligation: IndexedDB availability, open/upgrade outcome, the granted durability and the commit outcome are per-call `Backend` premises; the browser is assumed to honour `durability: 'strict'` when it reports it, a completed transaction is assumed durable, and readwrite transactions on the store are assumed serialized so one `remember` is one atomic step.

boundaries.name: stored-row-shape
boundaries.obligation: Rows read from the object store are assumed to have the `Decision` shape; the source reads arbitrary IndexedDB rows and only checks the listed fields.

boundaries.name: key-encoding-injectivity
boundaries.obligation: The JS key `JSON.stringify([signerPkG, channelId, prevDigest])` is modeled as the triple `LedgerKey`; injectivity of the string encoding is assumed.

boundaries.name: js-number-model
boundaries.obligation: JS numbers are abstracted as integers vs. non-integers (`Json.number` / `Json.nonInteger`); Number.isSafeInteger, NaN/Infinity and -0 are subsumed by the range checks, not modeled bit-exactly.

boundaries.name: single-store-scope
boundaries.obligation: Every theorem is about one `Store` lineage: other devices, browser profiles, origins or DB names, and cleared/evicted storage are outside the model, so cross-store equivocation is not prevented.

boundaries.name: signature-validity
boundaries.obligation: Falcon signature validity or randomization, the WASM signer and its state-transition/exit-kit checks are not modeled; signature bytes are opaque `Json` and delegate (unsigned) usage never touches the store.

boundaries.name: no-source-refinement
boundaries.obligation: The Lean definitions are handwritten semantics of the JavaScript; no refinement between the JS/WASM/browser execution and the model is proved.
